metadata.title: VMRay Email Attachment Analysis (Defender-visible)
metadata.description: Submits each attachment of an Office 365 email to VMRay and writes the analysis result to a Log Analytics custom table via the Logs Ingestion API. Unlike the original playbook this variant does NOT create the incident itself: a scheduled analytics rule (also created by this template) turns malicious/suspicious rows into Microsoft Sentinel incidents with File and FileHash entity mappings, so they correlate and surface in the Microsoft Defender portal incident queue. This single template creates the custom table, the Data Collection Endpoint, the Data Collection Rule, the two API connections, the playbook and the analytics rule.
metadata.prerequisites: VMRay API Key. The VMRay Enrichment Function App deployed to this resource group. A Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled, in this resource group.
postDeploymentSteps: Grant the playbook's system-assigned managed identity the 'Monitoring Metrics Publisher' role on the Data Collection Rule (see the dataCollectionRuleResourceId and playbookPrincipalId outputs). Without it the ingestion call returns 403.
Grant the playbook's system-assigned managed identity the 'Microsoft Sentinel Contributor' role on the Log Analytics workspace, so it can upload threat indicators.
Authorize the office365 API connection (interactive OAuth sign-in as the mailbox that receives the emails).
Set the 'Send an email (V2)' recipient - the template ships a placeholder address.
Enable the playbook - it deploys Disabled.

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics / Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Must live in this resource group.
Log Analytics Workspace ID (GUID). Used for the threat indicator upload.
Base name of the VMRay Enrichment FunctionApp. A 3-character hash derived from this resource group is appended, so the Function App must live in this resource group.
Log Analytics custom table to create. Must end with _CL.
Name of the Data Collection Endpoint to create.
Name of the Data Collection Rule to create.
Interactive retention for the custom table, in days.
Stable GUID for the analytics rule. Keep it constant across redeployments so the rule is updated rather than duplicated.
Severity assigned to the generated alerts and incidents.
Whether the analytics rule is enabled on deployment.

variables.analyticRuleQuery:
[concat(parameters('TableName'), '
| where ingestion_time() > ago(10m)
| where SampleVerdict in ("malicious", "suspicious")
| extend HashAlgorithm = "SHA256"
| extend Classifications = iff(isnull(SampleClassifications), "", strcat_array(SampleClassifications, ", "))
| extend ThreatNames = iff(isnull(SampleThreatNames), "", strcat_array(SampleThreatNames, ", "))
| project TimeGenerated, SubmissionId, SampleId, SampleFileName, SampleVerdict, SampleVtiScore, SampleWebifUrl, Classifications, ThreatNames, SampleVerdictReasonCode, SampleVerdictReasonDescription, SampleSha256, SampleMd5, HashAlgorithm, AttachmentName, EmailSubject, EmailSender, EmailRecipients')]

inputs.name: email_body
inputs.value:
Submission ID Submission Status Sample ID Sample Classifications Sample Threat Names Sample Webif URL Sample Verdict Sample VTI Score Sample Verdict Reason Code Sample Verdict Reason Description
@{body('GetVMRaySubmission')['submission_id']} @{body('GetVMRaySubmission')['submission_status']} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_id']} @{join(coalesce(body('GetVMRaySample')?['sample_classifications'], createArray()), ', ')} @{join(coalesce(body('GetVMRaySample')?['sample_threat_names'], createArray()), ', ')} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_webif_url']} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_verdict']} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_vti_score']} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_verdict_reason_code']} @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_verdict_reason_description']}

body.Subject: VMRay Email Attachment Scan for file - @{body('GetVMRaySample')['sample_filename']}

properties.displayName: VMRay - Malicious or suspicious email attachment
properties.description: VMRay sandbox returned a malicious or suspicious verdict for an attachment submitted by the VMRay-Sandbox_Outlook_Attachment playbook.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: VMRay returned verdict '{{SampleVerdict}}' for the email attachment {{AttachmentName}}. Full report: {{SampleWebifUrl}} . Sample and submission ids, hashes, classifications, threat names and the sender/recipient are available in the alert's custom details.
